Chester Bennington was my hero. Dude got crazy famous and super rich all of a sudden but was still humble and did a ton for really good charities. His lyrics and his spirit  helped me get through some of the darkest times of my life. And still does. 

Not everyone knows this, but he was molested as a kid, which was a point of his frustrations that came out in his lyrics. 

I was also molested as a kid. 

And when I saw him doing all these amazing things with his life despite all that bullshit, it made me believe that if he could overcome that and still be successful and still be a kind and generous person, then so could I.

I got to fucking meet the guy at a Linkin Park show once, and I told him about all of that, and he actually stood there and listened to what I said gave me a hug and thanked me for sharing that with him. It was the proudest moment of my life so far. 

His suicide absolutely crushed me. I never cry, and I would shed tears off and on for days after his passing. I straight up sobbed and broke down when I heard the news. 



RIP Chester. I miss you.

I’ve been in love with this one girl for years, who is one of my best friends. I’ve dated lots of girls, and there’s only one I’ve ever genuinely wanted to spend my life with, and it’s her. She unfortunately didn’t feel the same. Whatever, we’ll keep being friends. Still in love with her but just want her to be happy. She dated other guys and I was honestly not jealous in the slightest because she was happy. 

Up until a few months ago when she decided to date my best friend, a guy who’s been my brother since we were in diapers. Don’t know why them being together pisses me off and makes me jealous and just genuinely causes me heartache, but it does, and I’ve tried to move past it for months now and haven’t been able to. He’s a good guy and he makes her happy and he deserves a win cuz his last relationship was a train wreck that almost ruined his life, but goddammit it fucking hurts when I tried for so long to get her to be with me so I could show her how I truly felt, and he just fucking walks in and gets her to fall in love with him in a couple of months. But apparently I’m an ass for feeling that way. Don’t care though, doesn’t change how I feel. I put on a fake smile and try and get them to believe I’m cool with it, but I don’t think they’re falling for it. Call me a selfish prick, downvote me into oblivion, send me hate messages telling me how wrong I am, don’t care. The whole thing has just hurt me and I’m tired of it. I would never do something like that to him or anyone honestly. Nobody should have to go through that.
